title: 第7章 舍身战毒蝶 灵草解佳人第8章 滩涂战磷虾 少女初扬威
lines: 天色刚透一抹微白，黎明的寒意像冰丝般缠满白沙滩，整片天地还沉在半明半暗的昏蒙里。海风一阵紧过一阵，卷着细碎的沙粒打在火堆余烬旁，发出轻微而孤寂的声响。李紫云靠坐在石块上昏睡，眉头依旧因体内残留的毒素紧紧蹙着，小脸苍白得没有半分血色，连呼吸都带着几分微弱，看上去格外让人心疼。
罗止正蹲在她身旁，动作轻得不能再轻，指尖小心翼翼碰了碰她冰凉的手背。那一片触目惊心的青紫还残留在她的肌肤上，无时无刻不在提醒他，她正承受着怎样的痛苦。他心底那股自责与担忧翻涌而上，压过了所有恐惧与犹豫。他不能再等，更不能让她跟着自己再涉险境。
没有留下任何声响，他握紧了手中那根长棍，悄无声息地转身，独自踏入了黎明前最黑暗的林间。四周死寂得可怕，没有虫鸣，没有鸟叫，只有他踩在落叶上的轻响，以及胸腔里越来越沉重的心跳。海风在林间穿梭，带着刺骨的凉意，仿佛连空气都被冻得凝固，每一步前行，都像是在与这片沉默的危险对峙。
穿过空旷冷寂的东海空坪，他一路向南，不多时便踏入了清涟溪湾。溪水清澈却冰冷刺骨，他俯身捧起一口咽下，干涩发紧的喉咙才稍稍舒缓，混沌的脑子也彻底清醒过来。
然后他随手取下腰间的银月水囊，拧开塞子，将水囊整个浸入溪中。清澈的溪水缓缓灌入，不多时便装得满满当当。他晃了晃确认无误，重新塞紧塞子，系回腰间。
他没有多做停留，目光坚定地转向西侧，朝着柔藤漫坡而去。那里是彩翼毒蝶的领地，是昨日让他狼狈奔逃的地方，也是今日，他必须为她寻回生机的地方。
越靠近藤坡，空气中便漫开一股甜腻发闷的气息，滞重得让人呼吸发沉。整座坡地被密密麻麻的藤蔓彻底覆盖，粗藤如虬龙盘绕，细藤似乱网垂落，层层叠叠绞扭纠缠，铺成一片深绿近墨的死寂。藤蔓叶片肥厚蔫垂，四下寂静无声，看似繁茂的景象下，处处透着令人心悸的压抑与诡异。
罗止正深吸一口气，握紧手中长棍，脚步沉稳地踏入了坡地范围，目光在交错缠绕的藤蔓间仔细搜寻，想要寻得能为李紫云解毒疗伤的灵药。
可他身形刚一深入，一道绚烂却凶戾至极的彩影便骤然从藤叶间破空袭来！正是昨日一刺便让李紫云中毒的彩翼毒蝶。
它双翼斑斓如霞，流转着妖异光泽，却带着令人心悸的凶气。
这只凡级一阶后期的灵兽，拥有幻翼迷眼与轻身翩跹两大特性：翅光闪烁可持续干扰视线，令人难以锁定真身；体态轻盈飘忽，飞行轨迹难测，物理攻击极难命中。
一照面，它便没有任何试探，径直展开了最凌厉的攻势。
蝶翅尖端瞬间亮起刺目的光晕，强光直刺双眼。
这正是迷影扰目！
罗止正眼前骤然一片花白，视线彻底混乱。他咬牙强闭双目，凭借着灵气的微弱感应，横棍狂扫而出。可彩翼毒蝶本就身形轻盈到了极致，双翼微微一振，便化作一道飘忽不定的虚影。
这正是翩跹闪避！
轻轻松松便避开了他所有的攻击，甚至连棍风都没能触碰到它的羽翼。
下一秒，毒蝶已然俯冲而下，尾部那根泛着寒光的毒刺笔直刺出。
这正是毒刺扑击！
罗止正猛地侧身躲闪，毒刺依旧擦着他的肩头划过，皮肉瞬间被破开一道伤口，黑紫色的毒素以肉眼可见的速度顺着伤口蔓延开来，一阵钻心剧痛瞬间席卷全身。他强忍着痛楚，不退反进，长棍带着全身灵气疯狂砸出，招招都朝着毒蝶要害而去。可毒蝶依旧灵活游走，速度快得让人难以捕捉，无论他如何发力，都无法真正锁定目标。
更让他心头一沉的是，彩翼毒蝶的双翼开始高频震颤，发出尖锐而急促的嗡鸣。
这正是群蝶呼应！
它在召唤同类！一旦更多毒蝶赶来，他必死无疑。
罗止正心里清楚，一旦拖延下去，等到更多毒蝶赶来，他不仅救不了人，连自己都要死在这里。他不再保留，豁出一切强行近身搏杀，将自身速度与力量发挥到极致。可毒蝶的尾刺却如同附骨之疽，连连刺出，毒劲层层叠加。
一道道毒针接连落在他的手臂、肩背、腰腹之上，伤口瞬间发黑肿胀，毒素如同疯狂的毒蛇，顺着经脉疯狂侵入五脏六腑。四肢渐渐变得麻木沉重，视线也开始一阵阵发黑，剧痛、眩晕、无力，一层层将他淹没，鲜血顺着棍身不断滴落，浸透了身下干枯的藤蔓，在地上晕开一朵朵暗沉的血花。
他的意识渐渐模糊，身体早已达到极限，可脑海里，却始终挥之不去李紫云苍白虚弱的模样。就是这一丝执念，支撑着他拼尽最后一丝力气，在毒素彻底吞噬意识前的刹那，猛地怒吼一声，长棍带着全身仅剩的灵气，狠狠砸中了毒蝶的羽翼！
彩翼毒蝶发出一声凄厉的尖鸣，斑斓的羽翼重重垂落，身躯摔在藤蔓之间，挣扎数息之后，彻底没了气息。
可罗止正也再也支撑不住，双腿一软，直挺挺地倒在了地上。毒素如潮水般疯狂啃噬着他的经脉，每一寸肌肤都像是在被烈火灼烧，意识不断下沉，眼前的景物越来越模糊，他能清晰地感觉到，生命正在一点点从身体里流逝。
濒死的恍惚之间，他的手无意识地在身侧乱抓，指尖忽然触碰到一株柔软却带着微凉气息的草木。叶片清透，带着淡淡的霜色，看着颇为奇特，这正是玄霜蝶心草，凡级一阶灵药。他口干舌燥到了极点，意识早已模糊，根本不知道这株草有何作用，只是出于求生的本能，抓起来便塞进嘴里，大口咀嚼着咽下。
草汁入喉，一股清冽冰寒的灵气瞬间席卷四肢百骸，如同冰雪融化般流淌全身。原本在体内疯狂肆虐的毒素，竟以惊人的速度被压制、化解！发黑的伤口渐渐恢复了正常的血色，麻木的四肢重新找回了知觉，昏沉欲裂的脑袋也瞬间清醒过来。
更让他震惊的是，一股磅礴的灵气在体内疯狂冲刷着经脉，原本停留在凡级一阶中期巅峰的境界，在这一刻轰然松动，随即稳稳突破！
content_en:
The sky had just turned white, and the chill of dawn was like ice threads wrapped around the white sand beach. The whole world was still shrouded in half-light and half-darkness. The sea breeze came and went, carrying fine grains of sand and hitting them next to the embers of the fire, making a slight and lonely sound. Li Ziyun was sitting on a stone and fell asleep. His brows were still tightly knitted by the toxins remaining in his body. His face was so pale that there was no trace of blood, and even his breathing was a little weak, which made him look particularly distressed.
Luo Zhi was squatting next to her, his movements could not have been gentler, and his fingertips carefully touched the back of her cold hand. The shocking bruise still remained on her skin, reminding him all the time of the pain she was suffering. The self-blame and worry surged up in his heart, overwhelming all fear and hesitation. He couldn't wait any longer, let alone let her follow him into danger again.
Without leaving any sound behind, he tightened his grip on the long stick in his hand, turned around quietly, and stepped alone into the darkest forest before dawn. The surroundings were eerily silent, with no chirping of insects or birds, only the soft sound of his footsteps on the fallen leaves, and the increasingly heavy heartbeat in his chest. The sea breeze shuttled through the forest, carrying a biting chill, as if even the air was frozen solid. Every step forward seemed to be confronting this silent danger.
Passing through the empty and lonely East China Sea, he headed south and soon stepped into Qinglian Creek Bay. The stream was clear but freezing cold. He leaned over and took a gulp of it. Only then did his dry and tight throat soothe slightly, and his chaotic mind completely sobered up.
Then he casually took off the silver moon water bag from his waist, unscrewed the stopper, and immersed the entire water bag into the stream. The clear stream water slowly poured in, and it was filled to the brim in a short time. He shook it to make sure it was correct, tightened the gag again, and tied it back around his waist.
He didn't stop for much, and turned his gaze firmly to the west, heading towards the soft vine slope. That was the territory of the Colorful Winged Poison Butterfly. It was the place where he fled in embarrassment yesterday, and it was also the place where he had to find her life today.
As we get closer to the vine slope, a sweet and stuffy scent fills the air, making it so heavy that it makes people breathe heavy. The entire slope is completely covered with dense vines. The thick vines are coiled like horned dragons, and the thin vines hang down like tangled nets. They are twisted and entangled in layers, forming a deep green and almost ink-like silence. The leaves of the vines are thick and drooping, and there is silence everywhere. Under the seemingly lush scene, there is a heart-stopping depression and weirdness everywhere.
Luo Zhizheng took a deep breath, clenched the long stick in his hand, and stepped into the slope area with steady steps. His eyes searched carefully among the intertwined vines, hoping to find the elixir that could detoxify and heal Li Ziyun.
But as soon as he got deeper, a gorgeous but extremely ferocious colored shadow suddenly struck from the air among the vine leaves! It was the colorful-winged poisonous butterfly that poisoned Li Ziyun with just one sting yesterday.
Its wings are as colorful as clouds, flowing with an enchanting luster, but with a heart-stopping ferocity.
This late first-level mortal beast has two characteristics: phantom wings that confuse the eyes and a light and graceful body: the flickering light of its wings continuously interferes with the line of sight, making it difficult to locate its true body; its body is light and erratic, its flight trajectory is unpredictable, and it is extremely difficult to hit with physical attacks.
As soon as it came face to face, it launched the most ferocious offensive without any temptation.
The tip of the butterfly's wings suddenly lit up with a dazzling halo, and the bright light pierced his eyes.
This is cinephilia!
Luo Zhizheng's eyes suddenly turned gray, and his vision was completely confused. He gritted his teeth and closed his eyes, relying on the weak induction of spiritual energy to sweep out the horizontal stick. But the Colorful Winged Poison Butterfly's figure was extremely light, and when its wings fluttered slightly, it turned into an erratic shadow.
This is exactly what Pianying dodges!
It easily avoided all his attacks, and even the stick wind failed to touch its wings.
The next second, the poisonous butterfly swooped down, and the venomous stinger from its tail stabbed straight out.
This is the Stinger Pounce!
Luo Zhizheng suddenly dodged sideways, and the poisonous sting still scratched his shoulder. A wound was opened in the flesh in an instant. The black and purple toxin spread along the wound at a speed visible to the naked eye, and a heartbreaking pain instantly swept through his body. He endured the pain and advanced instead of retreating. The long stick was smashed out wildly with all the spiritual energy in his body, and every move was directed towards the poisonous butterfly's vitals. But the poisonous butterfly still swam flexibly, and its speed was so fast that it was hard to catch. No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't really lock on to the target.
What made his heart sink even more was that the wings of the colorful-winged poisonous butterfly began to vibrate at a high frequency, making a sharp and rapid buzzing sound.
This is exactly what the butterflies are responding to!
It's calling its kind! Once more poisonous butterflies arrive, he will definitely die.
Luo Zhizheng knew in his heart that if the delay continued and more poisonous butterflies arrived, not only would he not be able to save anyone, he would even die here. He no longer held back, risking everything to fight in close quarters, using his speed and strength to the extreme. But the poisonous butterfly's tail sting is like a gangrene attached to the bone, stabbing out one after another, and the poison is superimposed layer by layer.
Poisonous needles landed on his arms, shoulders, waist and abdomen one after another. The wounds instantly turned black and swollen, and the toxins were like crazy poisonous snakes, crazily invading the internal organs along the meridians. His limbs gradually became numb and heavy, and his vision began to darken in waves. Severe pain, dizziness, and weakness overwhelmed him layer by layer. Blood dripped down the stick body, soaking the dry vines under him, and dark blood flowers bloomed on the ground.
His consciousness gradually blurred, and his body had already reached its limit, but Li Ziyun's pale and weak appearance could not be left in his mind. It was this obsession that supported him to exert his last bit of strength. At the moment before the poison completely swallowed his consciousness, he roared violently, and the long stick hit the poisonous butterfly's wings with the remaining spiritual energy in his body!
The colorful-winged poisonous butterfly let out a shrill scream, its colorful wings fell heavily, and its body fell among the vines. After struggling for a few breaths, it completely lost its breath.
But Luo Zhizheng could no longer hold on, his legs softened, and he fell straight to the ground. Toxins were gnawing at his meridians like a tide, and every inch of his skin seemed to be burned by fire. His consciousness continued to sink, and the scene in front of him became increasingly blurry. He could clearly feel that life was passing away from his body bit by bit.
In a daze on the verge of death, his hands unconsciously scratched at his sides, and his fingertips suddenly touched a soft but cool plant. The leaves are clear, with a faint frost color, and look quite strange. This is the Black Frost Butterfly Heart Grass, a first-level mortal elixir. His mouth was extremely dry and his consciousness had long been blurred. He had no idea what the purpose of this grass was. Just out of survival instinct, he grabbed it and stuffed it into his mouth, chewing it and swallowing it.
When the grass juice enters the throat, a clear and cold aura instantly sweeps through the limbs and bones, flowing throughout the body like melting ice and snow. The toxins that were raging crazily in the body were suppressed and resolved at an alarming speed! The blackened wounds gradually returned to normal blood color, the numb limbs regained consciousness, and the dizzy head suddenly woke up.
What shocked him even more was that a majestic spiritual energy was rushing through the meridians in his body. He was originally at the peak of the mid-level first-order mortal level. At this moment, he suddenly loosened and then steadily broke through!
title_en: Chapter 7: Sacrificing one’s life to fight the poisonous butterfly, the spiritual grass solves the beauty Chapter 8: Fighting the krill on the tidal flat, the girl first shows her power
